old_caption: A hand holds a dark bottle above a clear glass containing crushed ice. A stream of liquid pours from the bottle into the glass, gradually increasing the liquid level. The glass sits on a dark, reflective surface, with some liquid spilled around its base. The pouring continues steadily throughout the sequence, with the ice remaining visible at the top of the glass.
original_wisa_caption: The video depicts a close-up scene where a hand is seen holding a knife, which is being used to cut through a block of ice placed inside a clear glass. The ice is initially intact but begins to break apart as the knife slices through it. The glass sits on a dark, reflective surface, likely a countertop or table, which captures some of the light and reflections from the ice and the knife. The background is slightly blurred, drawing focus to the action in the foreground. The lighting is bright enough to highlight the texture of the ice and the metallic sheen of the knife. As the knife continues to cut, pieces of ice fall into the glass, creating a dynamic visual effect. The sequence ends with the ice mostly broken up, with some remaining chunks still intact.
caption: The video depicts a clear glass tumbler heaped with a mound of white crushed ice, set on a dark glossy wet-looking surface with a faint haze drifting around the cup. In the upper-right corner a person's thumb and fingers hold a dark cylindrical nozzle pointed downward toward the ice. A thin stream descends from the nozzle onto the mound, at times faint and at times a narrow vertical line or short blurred column. This flow continues intermittently across the clip. The shape of the ice mound shifts as the right-side peak settles and a small distinct chunk comes to protrude from the top. The held nozzle and fingers gradually move out of the top-right of the frame while the framing drifts slightly, making the cup appear a touch larger and repositioned. The stream is no longer visible in the later frames, leaving the ice mound and the vapor as the scene stands.
